**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

Section 22 is the sole audit right binding us, and it satisfies every preferred element:

- **Frequency** — "no more than once in any twelve-month period" (§ 22.1)
- **Notice** — "at least thirty days' prior written notice" (§ 22.1)
- **Business hours** — "during normal business hours" (§ 22.1)
- **Independent auditor / confidentiality** — "an independent auditor bound by confidentiality" (§ 22.1)
- **Off-site** — "conducted off-site where practicable" (§ 22.1)
- **Cost allocation** — Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **No system access** — "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly" (§ 22.2)

§ 22.3 adds a favourable protection (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement). § 23 "Records and Customer Assurance" is a heading only, with no operative audit or inspection obligation, and no metering or remote-monitoring right appears elsewhere. No redline proposed.
